releaseName: Fewer false blockers and fuller drafts
summary: Hosted service, sprint 1w: fixes from the owner's re-walk of 0.7.0. A word-match coverage miss no longer blocks approval when the critic's only coverage findings are emphasis advice, and the review offers one button to mark every confirmed coverage gap as a known gap. The author's new prompt keeps one fact per bullet with no facts stitched together by semicolons, writes a summary of two to three sentences, keeps each fact in its role and matches each Core areas label to its content; when the evidence holds no name or contact details, the header shows placeholders to fill in. The bullet-spacing warning stops asking the author to merge short items, a bullet that joins separate facts with a semicolon gets a warning, and a header that still shows placeholders is named before approval and at export.
knownLimitations: Staging only: production keeps its earlier images until the owner deploys this tag there. Staging runs behind the owner token, so sign-in, plans and credits, and record export and deletion are not exercised there until the identity provider is hosted. Accepting a finding after the last round still changes nothing in the export: applying accepted fixes after the last round moved to a follow-up, and review edits do not reach the exported file, so header placeholders are filled in the exported document. The new author prompt has not had a paid run yet, and the cost of a complete cached run is still to measure (#1597).
